timeline.claim: Source discussed April 11 546 calls but deferred entry until a retracement and OMG close sequence.
Source stated an OMG fill for April 11 547 calls at 9.29.
Source stated a 9.85 target for the 547 calls and associated it with SPY 548.
A participant reported prior-day 565 puts from 9.31 to 20.00 and a stated $12,230 profit.
Source stated the OMG trade remained held while price moved below the entry context.
Source discussed whipsaws, false breakouts, and the need to distinguish a clean breakout from a head fake.
Source described a valid break as a move that returns to test the broken support or resistance and holds it.

claims.label: OMG_CALL_ENTRY
claims.claim: The source reported an April 11 547-call OMG fill at 9.29 with a stated 9.85 target.
claims.disconfirming_evidence_required: Broker fill records, deterministic OMG labels, synchronized option marks, and canonical ledger mapping.

claims.label: BREAKOUT_RETEST_ACCEPTANCE
claims.claim: The source distinguished a clean breakout from a head fake by whether price later tested and held the broken level.
claims.disconfirming_evidence_required: Timestamped bars, deterministic level and retest labels, negative controls, option marks, and independent fills.

claims.label: TARGET_NOT_FILLED_POSITION_HELD
claims.claim: The source described retaining the OMG position after the stated target sequence instead of reporting a confirmed exit.
claims.disconfirming_evidence_required: Time-stamped order and position history, actual fills, option marks, and a predeclared exit policy.

conflicts: The 9.85 547-call target is not a confirmed sale because the source later described holding the OMG position.
The 565-put profit is a participant claim about a prior session and has no speaker, contract, or broker reconciliation.
The transcript does not establish whether the 546-call discussion and 547-call fill represent one planned sequence.
unavailable_evidence: No canonical ledger mapping, broker fills, underlying bars, option bid/ask/mark data, or option excursion data was available.

counterfactuals.detail: The value of OMG, retest, and clean-break filters cannot be assessed without synchronized bars, executable option marks, fills, and baseline replay.

instrumentation_gaps: Deterministic OMG, breakout, retest, support, resistance, and moving-average labels
Broker fills, fees, and canonical ledger mapping
